text:
You need help applying unsupervised learning to coordinate data from 3D models to identify meaningful groups, with consulting, live sessions, and time for teaching along the way.

I’d be glad to help with that. I have 6 years of experience working with machine learning and Python-based data workflows, and I’m comfortable explaining concepts clearly while also staying hands-on with implementation. For this kind of project, I’d focus on understanding the coordinate structure first, then evaluating which unsupervised methods are most suitable for your data and your goal of finding groups. Depending on the shape and distribution of the coordinates, that could involve clustering approaches, feature preparation, and careful interpretation of the results. I can also make sure the work stays collaborative, so we can use live sessions to review assumptions, discuss tradeoffs, and cover the underlying concepts as needed.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and general machine learning. While this project is not an NLP task, I’m used to structuring exploratory ML work, testing approaches, and communicating findings in a way that is practical and easy to follow.

One relevant project I completed was **Product recommendations** for **Tidewater Outfitters** in e-commerce. I built similar items and “you-may-also-like” carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. That work led to a **14% increase in click-through rate in a 4-week A/B test**. It required thoughtful feature handling, experimentation, and translating model output into something useful for the business.

For your coordinate-data project, I’d be happy to support you with:
- choosing an appropriate unsupervised learning approach
- preparing and inspecting coordinate data from 3D models
- reviewing cluster quality and interpretation
- live consulting sessions
- teaching explanations as we go

If you’d like, I can help you move from raw coordinates to a clear grouping strategy in a structured, understandable way.
